_note: Per-edge adjudications of the interested-party rule (CLAUDE.md section 2). An edge whose every source is an AARO / DoD / DoW domain is capped at Tier 2 by merge.py unless its note attributes what the document says, OR it is listed here with a reason. This file exists because the docstring on remediate_edge_tiers() was right that a regex misreads an edge note: an office publishing its own report is a primary record, and no verb list captures that. So the regex handles the obvious cases and a person adjudicates the rest, here, where the decision is reviewable. Adjudicated 1 September 2026 from the 82 Tier 1 edges whose sources were all interested-party domains; 15 had notes the attribution pattern did not recognise. Each entry keeps or sets the tier and says why. To add one: a, b, type must match the edge exactly; tier is the tier the edge should carry; why is the argument.

edges.why: A temporal edge between two published documents. The documents themselves are the record of the sequence; no external fact is asserted.
The note reports what the DoD release statement acknowledges. Attribution; the pattern missed 'acknowledges' because of a regex bug fixed the same day.
Kirkpatrick's move to ORNL is an external fact about a third party's employment. AARO's UAP Records page is not the record of it; an ORNL announcement or press record would be.
An office and its own report. Self-publication is a primary record of the publication by definition.
An office and its own report. Self-publication is a primary record of the publication by definition.
An office and its own published imagery page. Self-publication.
The source is the establishment memorandum she signed. A signed instrument is the primary record of the act it performs.
The source is the official biography the employing office published for its acting director. The employer is the authority on its own appointments.
The figures in the note are the report's own contents, and the roundtable is the Department's own media event. Both are what the documents say.
Dates on the face of two records: the report carries its own date and the hearing record is sourced on its own node.
The note is a verbatim quotation from the establishment memorandum. A quotation is attribution.
A domain-to-domain analytic statement. The DODIG summary is a real document but the edge asserts an inference about how the domains relate, which is Tier 3 by the board's own definition.
Analytic inference about what aviator accounts imply for propulsion hypotheses. Not what the DoD release says.
Analytic inference. The DoD release authenticates the imagery; the edge asserts what multi-sensor corroboration means, which is the board's reasoning.
A statement about the federated IC structure and its seams. Inference, not a fact the Historical Record Report states.
The DoD release statement does not name San Diego or the operating area. The geography rests on other sourcing carried on the nimitz-2004 node.
